sentences.text:
..Applicants
 Vs.
 The State of Maharashtra ..Respondent

------------
 Aditya R. Iyer a/w Nyayosh B. a/w Advait H. for the
 Applicants.
Mr. S. H. Yadav, App for the State.

CORAM : M. S. KARNIK, J.
DATE : JANUARY 20, 2023 P.C. :

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned APP for the State.
2.
This is an application for pre-arrest bail.

The applicants are apprehending arrest in connection with First Information Report ("FIR" for short) No. 507 of 2022 dated 05/12/2022, registered with Kopar Khairane Police Station, for the offence punishable under sections 306 and 498A read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
3.
I am now informed that even section 304 has been added.
Applicant no. 1 is the mother-in-law and whereas applicant no. 2 is the sister-in-law of the deceased- Arti Darshan Patil 912-aba-194-23.doc Malhotra.
The allegations in the FIR are general in nature.
There is no mention of the demand for dowry or physical injuries caused to the deceased by the applicants.
The husband is already in custody.
The case of grant of interim protection is made out.

Kiran Ramesh Malhotra And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148365313/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Meantime in the event of arrest of the applicants in connection with FIR No. 507 of 2022,
registered with Kopar Khairane Police Station, the applicants- Kiran Ramesh Malhotra and Anjali Ramesh Malhotra be released on bail on their furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- each with one or more sureties in the like amount.

5. The applicants shall report to the Investigating Officer of the concerned Police Station on 23/01/2023 between 11.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m.
6.
Stand over to 02/02/2023.

(M. S. KARNIK, J.)
